title: Tiberi as unofficial mentor and his earlier Philadelphia career
summary: Tiberi helps younger players survive the road; before joining he was a successful Philadelphia studio musician and businessman.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: That does evoke some things about -- several people in the band are people who have been on the band, have told me that if it weren't for Frank, in a way, and his way of helping -- for instance, I think Andy Paddy LaVerne told me, he says, "Boy, I'll tell you, if I didn't get the kind of tutelage from -- counsel from Frank Tiberio, I could never not have lasted on the road. But he's done it, and he can help others make it."
Well, I would like to add something to that, which I don't think too many people think about. He had his whole career before he went on the road.

He was a successful studio musician in the Philadelphia area. He was contract r, he did this, he did that, he was called in on occasion if they needed miscellaneous instruments in the orchestra -- you know.
He'd done it all. He was a gray flannel suit man with a short haircut, he was successful in business with his former wife, and boutique and --
Oh, yes, many differet -- [It's why he stays] (unintelligible) in the record business. He sells the records. I have nothing to do with --
Yeah, no wonder he's so enterprising.
So he's had a big history and a big background with that. But he also decided that this is the way you find life. So he came out with us, he was already a mature man.
Well, it's interesting that -- he plays that unofficial role for the band.
